chunks: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh asked him, peace be upon him, about a man who becomes junub in a garment, while he has no other than it and is unable to wash it.
He said: “He should pray in it.”

key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.يُجْنِبُ: becomes junub, entering a state of major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he becomes junub in his only garment and cannot wash it before prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat when a person’s garment has become affected by janabah and no alternative garment is available. The Imam عليه السلام rules that he should still perform the prayer in that garment when he is unable to wash it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.753 - He was asked by Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Abdillah about a man who becomes ritually impure (junub) in a garment and has no other garment and is unable to wash it.
Imam (as) said: "He should pray in it."
